Kit summary

Data ErasureBasic
Deals 2 stages of DMG to a single enemy, each of which deals DMG by 14% of Heng'e 3's Max HP and extra DMG by 7% of Electric Bunny's stored Energy, this extra DMG ignores DEF. Besides, removes 1 layer of a random buff from the target. If the target doesn't have any buff, there is a 100% chance to inflict [Block Buff] for 1 turn.
Bionic BarrierActiveExclusive Lv.1
Grants 1 selected ally [Fictitious Defense] (considered as [Ally Protection]) for Heng'e 3's 3 turns. Heng'e 3 will take 50% of the DMG dealt to the ally with [Fictitious Defense] and the rest 50% will be converted into Energy, which will be absorbed and stored by the Electric Bunny for 2 turns, up to 100% of Heng'e 3's Max HP can be stored. If the ally with [Fictitious Defense] takes active DMG, Heng'e 3 will cast Data Erasure once on the attacker. When casting the skill to an ally with [Fictitious Defense], grants them 1 layer of [Block Debuff] for 2 turns and 1 layer of [Block Removal] for 2 turns; when casting the skill to self, restores 40% of Max HP.
Electric Bunny Lv.1Grants the target [Resolute II] for 2 turns when casting Bionic Barrier. If the target already has [Resolute], grants all allies [Resolute II] for 2 turns instead.
Data WarehousePassiveExclusive Lv.2
At the beginning of each wave, Heng'e 3 gains 54% Direct DMG and DoT Reduction, which will be gradually converted into 108% Max HP bonus within 6 turns. Also, when any ally's HP is lower than 50%, Electric Bunny will trigger Firewall: Heng'e 3 casts Bionic Barrier on the target immediately. This effect can be triggered up to 1 time every 3 turns.
Electric Bunny Lv.2At the beginning of turns of Heng'e 3 and the ally with [Fictitious Defense], Electric Bunny gains Energy equal to 5% of Heng'e 3's Max HP plus 10% of her lost HP, and restores Heng'e 3's HP by the same amount of Energy gained by Electric Bunny. Also, reduces Firewall's trigger interval by 1 turn.
Deconstructive ImpactActiveExclusive Lv.3
Extends all allies' [Fictitious Defense] by 1 turn. Electric Bunny grants all allies [Data Deconstruction] for 2 turns and deals 2 stages of DMG by 10% of Heng'e 3's Max HP each to all enemies. The first stage will remove all buffs from the targets and the second stage will inflict extra DMG by 44% of Electric Bunny's stored Energy. This extra DMG ignores DEF. [Data Deconstruction]: Additionally gains Crit DMG equal to 40% of Heng'e 3's initial Effect RES, up to 60%. The CD of this skill won't be affected by other effects.
Electric Bunny Lv.3When granting [Data Deconstruction], refreshes the duration of all buffs on allies with [Fictitious Defense] and extends [Data Deconstruction]'s duration to 4 turns. If Heng'e 3 has [Data Deconstruction] at the beginning of her turn, deals DMG by 22% of Electric Bunny's stored Energy to the enemy with the lowest HP percentage. This DMG ignores DEF.
